title: Commissioning run: four task contracts need correction
summary: Two evidence tasks have citation-oracle ambiguity, and two code answers were rejected by sandbox restrictions absent from the prompts. The execution and restoration receipts are valid; the recorded counts are not a trusted comparative quality baseline.
interpretation: Preserve every original outcome. Channel-marker leakage, empty-at-cap criticism, multiple JSON objects and positive game regret remain observed operational failures of this declared stack. They are separate from the four task-design defects.
next_action: Publish a corrected prospective release with a complete 21-task contract preflight. Keep the same task families and October 14 review boundary; do not repair or rescore this run.
